businesses.business: small business SaaS and marketing services

offering_description.value: Provides a cloud-based SaaS platform (Thryv) that helps small businesses manage customers, appointments, invoicing, payments and online presence. Also sells digital marketing services and, in a declining legacy line, print directories to small and medium-sized businesses. Delivered via software subscriptions and agency-style marketing services.

primary_products.value: small business management software (SaaS); print and digital directories (legacy); website and listings tools

primary_services.value: digital marketing services; search engine optimization; social media and advertising management; website design; reputation management

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and medium-sized businesses, especially home services and local service providers

end_markets.value: small business services; home services; professional services; local retail and healthcare practices

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly or annual SaaS platform subscriptions; service fees: digital marketing and advertising management services; advertising: print directory advertising sold to local businesses

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and hosts a cloud business management platform sold to small businesses; service provider: delivers marketing services to small businesses using platform and third-party ad channels

geography_served.value: North America: United States primarily, with operations in Canada, Australia and New Zealand

specialization.value: related lines: SaaS platform, marketing services and legacy print directories, all sold to small businesses

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: field and telesales representatives selling to small businesses; online: website self-signup and digital acquisition of software subscriptions; partners / resellers: channel partners and referral partners reselling the platform

regulatory_exposure.value: low: general business rules, data privacy, payment and telemarketing/consumer protection rules apply

notes: Details on the current mix and international footprint are from memory and may be outdated.
